Description: Digital elevation model (height above mean sea level). In the model, this is only used to calculate slope, which defaults to 0.0005 m/m. In the NanoFASE data module, it is used to calculate numerous [secondary variables](netcdf-namelist-input:secondary-derived-variables) for input to the model. Standard name: `height_above_mean_sea_level`

Required or optional: Required, unless derived from other runoff components (see [](input-data:hydrology))
Description: Also called surface runoff, this is the component of runoff that is responsible for driving soil erosion delivery and dissolved contaminant wash-off. Variable name set by `surface_runoff_variable` in the `&hydrology` model config group. Standard name: `surface_runoff_flux`
Potential source: Usually obtained from a hydrological model

Required or optional: Required, unless derived from other runoff components (see [](input-data:hydrology))
Description: This is the total runoff (subsurface and surface) that is routed by the model to provide surface water flows. Variable name set by `total_runoff_variable` in the `&hydrology` model config group. Standard name: `runoff_flux`
Potential source: Usually obtained from a hydrological model

Required or optional: Optional, only read if named by `subsurface_runoff_variable` in the `&hydrology` model config group
Description: Sub-surface runoff, used to derive total or surface runoff when only one of them is provided (see [](input-data:hydrology))
Potential source: Usually obtained from a hydrological model

Description: Amount of precipitation, used to drive soil percolation and soil erosion. Standard name: `rainfall_flux`
Residence time of water in each grid cell's groundwater store (see [](input-data:groundwater)). Zero, negative or fill values fall back to the constant.
Fraction of each grid cell's groundwater recharge that leaves the model. Negative or fill values fall back to the constant.
Fraction of each grid cell's sub-surface runoff that recharges the groundwater store. Negative or fill values fall back to the constant.
Fraction of each grid cell's surface runoff that recharges the groundwater store. Negative or fill values fall back to the constant.
Residence time of water in the groundwater store. Zero or negative switches the store off.
Fraction of sub-surface runoff that recharges the groundwater store, between 0 and 1.
Fraction of surface runoff that recharges the groundwater store, between 0 and 1. Does not change the surface runoff that drives erosion delivery.
Fraction of groundwater recharge that leaves the model, between 0 and 1.
Water in the groundwater store at the start of the run. Negative values start the store at steady state with the mean recharge.
